{{Top}}
{{Quote|The micro-grenade launcher is a devastating weapon, but make sure that you replace the magnetic rings that propel the explosive. During a firefight on Maro Della, the rings&mdash;which had degraded after repeated use&mdash;failed and jammed a grenade in the barrel. I only had a couple of seconds to toss the gun before the grenade detonated.|Hyannis, ''Gundark's Gear Datalog''|<ref name="Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Ld-1_target_blaster_rifle.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[LD-1 target blaster rifle]] had a long barrel]]
A '''barrel''' was the exit tube of a [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]], [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]], or [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] for the weapon's projectile or blaster bolt.

The barrels of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were inlaid with [[Galven circuit/Legends|galven circuitry]] which served to focus the weapon's energy bolt. The barrels were also fitted with [[static pulse adaptor]]s.<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref>

Certain rifles had long barrels, such as the [[Adventurer slugthrower rifle/Legends|Czerka Adventurer]] and the [[LD-1 target blaster rifle]]. Some long-barreled weapons were known as [[Longblaster/Legends|longblasters]]. Some weapons had two barrels, such as the [[double-barreled blaster carbine]] and the [[Duo blaster carbine]].
